description: Turn a list of products you already found (ids from search_products) into a link the person opens themselves, prefilled with those products, so Cbest's adviser continues from the list and Cbest issues a quote after checking price and stock. Returns NO price and NO stock, places no order, and stores nothing: the request exists only once the person opens the link and verifies their own number. Every id is checked against the catalog and unknown ids are reported back in unknownIds, never silently dropped. At most 30 items. The link's one-line field takes 120 characters, so a long list travels in part — the answer says exactly which items the link carries.

client.description: Optional: a short name for your app, so we can tell which assistants send people here. Self-reported, lowercase slug.

items.description: The products to quote, 1 to 30. Each id once.

product_id.description: Product id exactly as search_products returned it: 'brand/product-slug'.

qty.description: How many. Omit if the person has not said.

note.description: Optional, short: what the list is for ('shop, 40m², warm white'). No personal details: refused if it contains a phone number, an email or a handle.

name: request_quote
title: Ask Cbest for a quote on chosen products
